title: 文远知行韩旭：3000辆绑定合同，中东欧洲交付如何分步走？
speaker: Tony Han

segments.en: Yeah, and Tony, talk us through this 3000 binding global taxi contracts, right?
segments.zh: Tony，请谈谈这3000份全球出租车约束性合同的情况？

segments.en: What is sort of the delivery pace that you expect this to be across, you know, markets in the Middle East, in Europe, in Asia Pacific, are they going to be phased, you know, tell
segments.zh: 你预计在中东、欧洲、亚太等市场的交付节奏如何？是分阶段进行吗？请

segments.en: us a bit more about regionally, how this is all going to be delivered.
segments.zh: 再谈谈区域上具体如何交付。

segments.en: So currently we have already more than 600, 600 global taxi in Middle East region.
segments.zh: 目前我们在中东地区已有超过600辆全球出租车。

segments.en: If you click compared to July 31st, I in the midpoint of this year, we have already got 50% of growth and currently we have covered all the core areas of Dubai, core district area
segments.zh: 与7月31日年中相比，我们已实现50%的增长，目前覆盖了迪拜所有核心区域。

segments.en: of Dubai and Al-Qaeda, and you know, these days if you are tourist, you go to Al-Qaeda in Dubai, you will find out the black car, global taxi from Uber and we write as everywhere.
segments.zh: 如今游客去迪拜Al-Qaeda，会看到Uber和WeRide的黑色全球出租车随处可见。

segments.en: And I'm quite proud and honored to announce like we write become Uber's largest partner
segments.zh: 我很自豪地宣布，WeRide成为Uber海外市场最大合作伙伴。

segments.en: in the overseas market. And so overall, I think in that region, we will keep on growing.
segments.zh: 总体而言，我认为该地区业务将持续增长。

segments.en: And also I want to talk about Europe, and we have some big contract with Uber.
segments.zh: 我还想谈谈欧洲，我们与Uber有重大合同。

segments.en: And so we will deploy massive global taxi in Madrid.
segments.zh: 我们将在马德里部署大量全球出租车。

segments.en: And we are also continuing considering other European cities together with Uber.
segments.zh: 我们也在与优步一起考虑其他欧洲城市。

segments.en: And so overall, I think to expand the global market, we are building our sales network, deployment network, and sharpening our technology and doing some local adaptation.
segments.zh: 总体而言，为了拓展全球市场，我们正在构建销售网络和部署网络，同时提升技术并进行本地化适配。

segments.en: So we are very excited to expand in the Middle East region.
segments.zh: 因此，我们对在中东地区拓展业务感到非常兴奋。
